# Crates permitted in the normal dependency tree of soroban-failure-analysis.
#
# That crate must perform no I/O (see docs/architecture/purity.md). This list is
# checked by scripts/check-analysis-purity.sh in CI. A crate that is not listed
# fails the build.
#
# Each entry is a crate NAME, one per line. Versions are deliberately not pinned
# here, so routine dependency updates do not touch this file.
#
# To add a crate, you must explain in the PR why it cannot perform network,
# filesystem, clock, environment or randomness access at runtime. Crates that
# only run at build time, such as derive macros, are listed as "(proc-macro)"
# below and count as safe because they are not linked into the library.
#
# Also check: the script only inspects the tree as resolved with default
# features. Build scripts and dev-dependencies are excluded by --edges normal.

soroban-failure-analysis

# Canonical XDR and strkey implementations. Pure data encoding.
stellar-xdr
stellar-strkey

# Serialisation (optional `serde` feature, enabled by default).
serde
serde_core
serde_json
serde_with
serde_with_macros
serde_derive
schemars

# Pure encoding and hashing.
base64
data-encoding
hex
ethnum
escape-bytes
sha2
digest
crypto-common
generic-array
block-buffer
cpufeatures
typenum
cfg-if
itoa
memchr
dyn-clone

# Derive-macro support (proc-macro, build time only).
cfg_eval
darling
darling_core
darling_macro
ident_case
strsim
proc-macro2
quote
syn
unicode-ident
zmij
